items.definition: A tool with a weighted head used to strike nails or shape materials.
A hinged hand implement that grips, bends, or cuts wire and small objects.
A toothed blade operated by hand to cut wood or other materials.
A motor-driven device that rotates a bit to bore holes or drive fasteners.
A sharp-edged metal blade struck or pushed to cut and shape hard material.
A hardened implement with rough ridges used to smooth or shape surfaces.
A compact cutting implement with a replaceable retractable blade for general tasks.
A short bent metal rod used to turn fasteners with six-sided sockets.
A flexible marked strip that extends from a case to measure distances.
A straight measuring instrument with liquid-filled vials that show whether a surface is level.
A device that holds materials firmly together, often while they are being worked on.
A fixed workshop device with opposing jaws that securely hold an object during work.
A pointed hand implement used to pierce small holes in leather, wood, or similar materials.
A heated electrical implement used to melt metal alloy and join electronic components.
A portable case with compartments for carrying and storing hand implements.
A woodworking implement with a blade that shaves thin layers from a surface.
A long-handled implement with a broad blade for lifting and moving loose material.
A long-handled garden implement with teeth for gathering leaves or loosening soil.
A long-handled garden implement with a flat blade for cultivating soil and removing weeds.
A cleaning implement with bundled bristles used to sweep dirt from floors or outdoor surfaces.
A portable structure with parallel rails joined by steps for climbing to higher places.
A small cart with one wheel, handles, and a tray for transporting loads by hand.
A small hand implement with a flat blade for digging, planting, or spreading mortar.
A spring-operated cutting implement used to trim small branches and stems.
A piece of furniture designed for one person, usually supported by legs and fitted with a back.
A piece of furniture with a flat top supported above the floor for work or dining.
A piece of furniture with a flat work surface, often including drawers or storage compartments.
A piece of furniture with horizontal surfaces arranged to hold books and other objects.
A piece of furniture with enclosed storage space, often fitted with shelves or drawers.
A piece of furniture designed to support a person while sleeping or resting.
A tall piece of furniture with doors for storing clothing and personal belongings.
A seat without arms or a back, commonly supported by three or four legs.
A round, crisp fruit with edible skin and flesh surrounding several small seeds.
A long, curved tropical fruit with a soft, sweet interior and peel.
A round citrus fruit with a fragrant rind and segmented, juicy flesh.
A small, smooth-skinned fruit that grows in clusters and may be green, red, or purple.
A sweet fruit with a rounded base, narrow upper portion, and thin edible skin.
A soft, fuzzy-skinned fruit with sweet flesh surrounding one large, hard stone.
A yellow citrus fruit with tart juice and a strongly scented outer rind.
A small red fruit with tiny seeds across its surface and a leafy cap.
